## Description

Trades two maturities or duration-hedged bond exposures to profit from a change in curve slope rather than the overall level of rates.

## Where it may fit

Macro regimes with curve repricing, central-bank policy shifts or changing growth/inflation expectations.

## Vehicles

Rates hedge funds, global macro, bond relative-value and fixed-income futures funds.

## Required data

Yield curve points, bond/futures prices, duration/DV01, coupons, financing, roll, auction calendar and contract specs.

## Caveats

DV01 matching does not eliminate convexity, carry, basis or curve-shape risk; model cheapest-to-deliver and futures delivery options.
